evidence_slice: City of Doncaster Council's public adopted Local Plan Policies Map service exposes layer 6 'Site Allocations' as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700, with labels driven by the Ref field and a Housing Allocation category. The council's planning committee report for application 22/00255/REMM states that the Mere Lane, Edenthorpe site forms part of a larger area allocated for residential development in the Local Plan under reference MUA51 and describes the application as 248 dwellings, including 25 affordable and 223 open-market homes. The council's live planning portal records application 26/00054/FULM for the same site, received and validated on 12 January 2026, with consultation shown through 13 September 2026 and status awaiting decision.
